newsitem.title: USA: Geotek gets investment, raises $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Geotek gets investment, raises $50 mln.

text.p: Geotek Communications Inc said it raised $50 million by selling a new series of convertible stock and that affiliates of the Soros Group will invest an additional $25 million in the company.
The affiliates of the Soros Group, as well as the Chatterjee Group, will invest through a separate series of convertible preferred stock, the company said.

The stock will have similar terms to the stock the company sold to a group of institutional investors to raise $50 million. Those investors include affiliates of Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, the Palladin Group and Promethean Investment Group, the company said.

The preferred stock will pay common stock dividends at a rate of 10 percent a year and be converted into shares of common stock, the company said. The company also said it issued warrants to buy another 2.5 million shares of common stock in connenction with the two transactions.
The warrants will have an exercise price fixed at a 30 percent premium above Geotek's stock price at closing.
The company's stock was up 1 1/4 in late afternoon trading at 8 3/8. It touched a high of 8 5/8 earlier in the day.
